scope: packaging only: freeze the annotation-v3-retrain-v4 seed-1 INT8 encoder (type + target) together with the unchanged rule-based value parser (gidi.value_parser) and the whole-word target snap into one release. No training, no re-training, no seed change, no architecture/tokenizer/vocabulary/annotation/taxonomy change, no new data, no threshold change, no special-casing of any note. models/gidi-finance-v1 and models/gidi-finance-v2 are not modified.
architecture: annotation-v3-retrain-v4 seed 1: compression-v3 recipe (pretrained BamiBERT-derived 4x768 encoder, layers 2,5,8,11, FFN 2048 combined criterion, 34 position rows, vocabulary B-rank-8000 with 8,338 tokens, max_length 32), supervised on training-v4 with annotation-v3 labels; type head (8 classes) + target BIO head, ONNX INT8 (dynamic, QInt8 weights). Same ONNX interface as gidi-finance-v1: inputs input_ids/attention_mask, outputs type_logits/tag_logits. No neural value head: the value span is produced by the deterministic parser gidi.value_parser.parse_value on the caller's string (config.json value_source rule-parser, value_parser.version pinned). The decoded first target span is extended to whole words (config.json target_snap words; gidi.inference.decode.snap_span_to_words). Tokenizer, tokenizer_config and vocab map are byte-identical to gidi-finance-v1.

seed_selection.rule: seed 1, the release candidate fixed in experiments/annotation-v3-retrain-v4/protocol.json before any model of that run was trained, exported or scored (the deployment convention of every earlier run). The candidate was not chosen among seeds 1-3 by any held-out score.
seed_selection.why_not_held_out_metrics: selecting the seed by test/probe/human-value results would select on evaluation sets and bias every number reported for the released model

value_decoding_rule: none: no value head. The value span is gidi.value_parser.parse_value(text) (offsets in code points of the caller's string, None when the note holds no amount); Prediction value_confidence is null because the rule parser has no score.
target_snap_rule: the decoded first target span is extended outward to whole words (maximal non-whitespace runs, edge punctuation of the extension trimmed), exactly gidi.inference.decode.snap_to_words; member tokens, and therefore target_confidence, are unchanged.
evaluation_sets_report_only: frozen test, probe-v1, human-value-01 and human-value-02 (LLM-labelled by two independent labellers with adjudication) are used only to report quality, never to select, tune or special-case. Numbers: experiments/annotation-v3-retrain-v4/results.json, experiments/annotation-v3-retrain-v5/results-hv02.json (system run4), experiments/deployment-v3/hv02-release-check.json.
thresholds: none; confidences are uncalibrated scores, abstention policy is left to a later calibration phase
acceptance_gate: bundle reproducible from the sources (freeze_deployment --check byte-identical); every bundle file matches manifest.json
INT8 model equals the ONNX the run-4 held-out runs scored (sha256 61c17d27b92e1ac4ac1add0af73344cb1c68bdbbc19db58532ce6d38d9bb7315, 28,658,533 bytes)
GidiPredictor.from_bundle(models/gidi-finance-v3) with no flags reproduces the run-4 human-value-02 numbers exactly (type 0.9211, target exact 0.8526, value exact 1.0, end-to-end 0.7895 on 190 notes)
gidi-finance-v1 and gidi-finance-v2 bundles load and predict exactly as before (no snap, v2 value from its CRF head)
release verify passes: hashes, runtime config accepted by the runtime loader, INT8 and FP32 smoke predictions match the spec
on_gate_failure: stop and report the blocker; no retraining, no seed change
